title: Interview scheduling and calendar coordination
summary: Replace scheduling email tennis with one self-scheduling link backed by live free/busy checks, atomic slot reservation, and time-zone-safe calendar invites.

faq.q: How do you avoid double-booking interviewers?
faq.a: Check each interviewer's real free/busy availability at the moment of booking and reserve the slot atomically, so two candidates can never claim the same time.

faq.q: What time zone should interview invites use?
faq.a: Always present times in the candidate's own time zone and store the absolute instant, so an interview never drifts by an hour across a daylight-saving change.

faq.q: How do you schedule a panel interview across busy calendars?
faq.a: Compute the live free/busy intersection of the whole panel, hold the chosen slot for every member atomically, and rebuild the event set when any interviewer changes rather than patching it by hand.

faq.q: What scheduling rules protect interviewers from overload?
faq.a: Working-hours windows, buffers between interviews, and daily interview caps, enforced by the slot engine itself so the humane schedule is the default rather than a manual favour.
